contract.name: CastalienProtocol
contract.desc: ARC-4 Smart Contract powering the CASTALIEN AI Oracle & Loyalty Ecosystem on Algorand Mainnet (https://algo.alpheon.org/).

methods.name: configure_assets
methods.desc: Opts the smart contract application account into Alpheon (ALP) and Castalia (CST).

methods.name: notarize_oracle_report
methods.desc: Anchors a 1KICHING or Astronomical Saju AI consultation report hash on-chain.

methods.name: verify_oracle_report
methods.desc: Read-only ABI method allowing any user or auditor to verify whether a given AI consultation report matches the immutable SHA-256 digest stored on-chain.

methods.name: claim_daily_faucet
methods.desc: Distributes 8 ALP (ASA 3706444728) once every 24 hours (86,400s) to a verified Pera Wallet holder opted into Alpheon.

methods.name: atomic_swap_algo_for_alp
methods.desc: Accepts native ALGO payment (>= 1 ALGO) in an atomic transaction group and instantly settles Alpheon (ALP) at 1 ALGO = 1,024 ALP.
